Max Electric Inc. is a fully licensed and insured residential electrical contractor. We provide high-quality electrical services to our residential customers in the MidSouth.

Our highly trained residential electricians specialize in inspecting, repairing, and replacing the electrical in your home. It’s our job to make sure your home is free of electrical hazards and safe for you and your loved ones. Your safety is our #1 concern! We offer our customers a wide range of residential electrical services. View our Services & get inspired from our work.

Our team of trained electricians are dedicated to providing quality work and service that will exceed your expectations.

We are 100% satisfaction guaranteed, licensed, bonded and insured in MS and TN.
